map.点击率 CTR = 点击数 ÷ 曝光数 × 100%；两版差异 = CTR-B: Click-through rate CTR = clicks / impressions x 100%; the difference between the two versions = CTR-B - CTR-A, and the relative lift = difference / CTR-A x 100%. The winner is the one with the higher CTR, and a verdict requires a minimum sample size (at least 1000 impressions per group) plus a relative lift above 5% to count as significant. A two-proportion z-test can evaluate significance: z = (p1 - p2) / sqrt(p(1-p)(1/n1 + 1/n2)), and |z| above 1.96 is significant at the 95% confidence level.
map.封面 A/B 测试：同一内容投放两版封面，各记录展示量与点击量，用 CTR 比出: Cover A/B test: run two cover versions on the same content, record impressions and clicks for each, and compare CTR to pick the winning version.
map.相对提升判定：不只看绝对 CTR，更看相对提升幅度，避免「样本小导致虚高」误判。: Relative-lift verdict: look at the relative lift rather than the absolute CTR alone, to avoid misjudging a small sample as artificially high.
map.显著性建议：CTR 差异达 20% 判为显著、10–20% 为「有一定差异」需加: Significance guidance: a CTR gap of 20% is significant, 10-20% means "some difference" and needs more samples, and below 10% is not significant so the variant should be replaced.
map.算例（封面A 展示10000/点击500，封面B 展示10000/点击680）: Worked example (cover A 10000 impressions / 500 clicks, cover B 10000 impressions / 680 clicks)
map.封面A CTR = 500÷10000×100% = 5.00%；封面B CTR: Cover A CTR = 500/10000 x 100% = 5.00%; cover B CTR = 680/10000 x 100% = 6.80%. Difference = 6.80% - 5.00% = +1.80%; relative lift = 1.80% / 5.00% x 100% = 36.0%. Because the relative lift is >= 20%, the result is judged "significantly different" and variant B is recommended. The tool outputs "variant A/B CTR -> difference -> relative lift" and gives a significance conclusion.
map.CTR 怎么算、多少算好？: How is CTR computed and what counts as good?
map.CTR = 点击量 ÷ 展示量 × 100%；行业各异，信息流封面通常 3–8%: CTR = clicks / impressions x 100%. It varies by industry, and for feed-style covers 3-8% is normal; higher means the cover catches the eye more. Here B at 6.80% beats A at 5.00%.
map.为什么看相对提升而非绝对差？: Why look at relative lift rather than the absolute gap?
map.绝对差 1.8% 在小样本下可能不稳健；相对提升（36%）能反映 B 相对 A: An absolute gap of 1.8% may be unstable with a small sample, while the relative lift (36%) reflects how much B improves on A; combined with
